description.narrative:
The outputs of the proposed Urban Project Preparatory Facility for Sri Lanka include (i) feasibility studies and detailed designs of urban projects completed; (ii) advance implementation support for two ensuing projects provided; and (iii) institutional capacity of implementing agencies strengthened. The outputs will result in the following outcome: high level of urban project readiness achieved. The project will be aligned with the following impact: urban projects in strategic cities and towns implemented in a timely manner. The TA loan will develop two projects listed in the country operations business plan (COBP), 2018-2020. Subproject selection criteria were prepared together with executing agencies, and projects to be developed under the UPPF were initially identified during fact-finding mission. Areas of value addition for ADB include piloting innovative approaches such as high-level technology to improve operational efficiency, reduce greenhouse gas emissions, and address climate change impacts.
An attached transaction technical assistance (TA) of $1.0 million funded on a grant basis by ADB's Technical Assistance Special Fund (TASF-6) will provide capacity building and implementation support to the executing agencies in areas of procurement, technical appraisal, safeguards, disaster and climate change, governance improvement, strategic planning, financial management, revenue generation, and operational and maintenance capacity for improved service delivery.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President
Reports and Recommendations of the President
Loan 3706: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 11 Mar 2025

Progress Toward Outcome: Ongoing. Consultants engages under the facility supported Ministry of provincial Council and Ministry of Urban development and Housing to conduct feasibility studies, detailed designs, and procurement.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Aug 2023: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/51297/51297-001-apfs-en_4.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: Feasibility studies for 20 out of 25 local authorities under Secondary Towns Sustainable Development Project (STSDP) and all four towns (Dambulla, Trincomalee, Karunagella, and Ratnapura) under Sustainable Urban Development Project (SUDP) were prepared with climate- and disaster-resilient and gender-inclusive features. Traffic and Transportation plans for 3 towns were prepared. The government will be able to utilize these documents for future investment projects in those local authorities and towns, For the proposed Sri Lanaka Tourism Sector Development Program, subprojects preparation in two towns (Trincomalee and Dambulla) are ongoing under the Ministry of Urban Development and Housing using the facility. MUDH developed a capacity building plan identifying the training to be conducted in 2023. All trainings are completed with at least 30% of women participation Gender Equality and Social Inclusion (GESI) plans for 7 participating local authorities have been prepared.
